scientific_integrity: All-n proof from explicit acyclic matching, intersection graph counting, primitive winding classes, van Kampen and homological Whitehead. Finite standard-library verification for 243 proper/full subsets and orientation complexes does not substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Full forward rotation family and a nonempty proper subset of reverse rotations; nonequivariant integral homotopy only. The full reverse endpoint is an established earlier result. No independent mathematical validation or comprehensive priority certification.
title: A gap-sensitive sphere-wedge transition for partially reversed cyclic permutation complexes
